messages:
ashley: Quick heads up — we need a staggered drain of a subset of serving nodes in us-west1 tonight to apply a kernel micropatch. Planned window: 2026-05-02 22:00–22:45 UTC. Impact: transient tail-latency spikes (5–15s) for a small percentage of routes; autoscaling and fallback policies should prevent errors but may increase cost. Posting status page + customer email below. @oncall-uswest please ack and take primary for the window.

sam: ack — I'm oncall US-WEST tonight, i'll be primary. i'll prep canary for the first batch at 22:00 and watch QPS/latency.

ops-bot: Incident thread created: 4598765432. Pager route: oncall-uswest. Runbook: rolling-drain-v2.

ashley: Draft statuspage update (please review):
```
Status: Maintenance in progress
Components: hosted inference (us-west1)
Start time: 2026-05-02 22:00 UTC (estimated)
Expected impact: brief latency degradation for a small subset of requests; no expected request failures.
Updates: We'll post when the window starts, after the first batch, and on completion.
```

lee: tiny nit: change "no expected request failures" -> "no widespread request failures expected; transient timeouts possible" to be conservative.

maria: Customer notification draft (support template):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance — brief performance impact in US-West (May 2)
Hi <CustomerName>,
We will conduct a brief maintenance window in the US-West region on 2026-05-02 at 22:00 UTC to apply a kernel security patch to hosting nodes. During this window you may see short-lived increases in response latency (typically <30s for affected requests) and in rare cases transient timeouts. Your requests will automatically failover to healthy capacity when possible. No action is required on your side.
If you rely on strict latency SLAs please reach out to support and we can advise on mitigation options.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

support-ops: I'll queue the customer batch for customers with dedicated capacity and those subscribed to "maintenance alerts". Will include the opt-out link.

sam: Preflight checklist for 21:30 UTC: confirm canary model fallback is active, KV cache warmed, A/B routing pinned for canary. I'm running smoke tests at 21:45 and will paste results here.

ops-bot: Reminder: set temporary routing policy to prefer regional fallback after 3s latency threshold — command:
```
redwood route update --region us-west1 --fallback-region us-east1 --threshold 3000
```

ashley: If canary looks good we'll proceed with batch 1 (10% serving nodes) at 22:00; batch 2 at 22:15 (30%); batch 3 at 22:30 (remaining). We'll hold and roll back if errors > 0.5% or P95 latency > 2s sustained for 2+ minutes.

sam: 21:50 smoke tests: generation endpoint OK (latency < 200ms), embeddings small test OK, kv-cache warm. ready to start.

incident-bot: Paging oncall-uswest -> sam at 22:00 UTC for scheduled maintenance.

(22:00) sam: starting batch 1 now — draining 10% nodes. Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood/ops/us-west1

lee: Observed small P95 blip to ~800ms for a minute, no increase in errors. continuing.

sam: batch 1 completed at 22:04, no rollbacks. posting statuspage update.

ashley: statuspage update posted: "Maintenance started; initial batch completed with no errors. Monitoring ongoing."

support-ops: I sent customer email batch A (dedicated + alert subscribers) at 22:06. Template used with minor personalization.

sam: starting batch 2 at 22:15 (30%). Keeping an eye on fallback region traffic.

lee: seeing a small spike in cross-region traffic to us-east1, P50 latency up but P95 stable. errors still within baseline.

sam: batch 2 completed 22:20. all good. moving to final batch at 22:30. handing primary to @lee for the last batch as i need to step out at 22:25.

lee: ack handoff. starting final batch at 22:30.

(22:34) lee: final batch completed at 22:34. total maintenance end 22:34 UTC. no rollback required.

ops-bot: Maintenance complete (4598765432). Summary: rolling drain + kernel patch applied in us-west1, no widespread failures, transient latency spikes observed.

ashley: Final statuspage update draft:
```
Status: Maintenance complete
Components: hosted inference (us-west1)
Start time: 2026-05-02 22:00 UTC
End time: 2026-05-02 22:34 UTC
Impact: brief latency increases for a small portion of traffic during migration batches; no widespread request failures.
Follow-up: If you saw any unexpected errors, please open a support ticket and include request IDs if available.
```

maria: I'll follow up with a short post-maint customer note to the same recipients and tag any customers who reported issues.

support-ops: No customer tickets opened related to this window other than one private message that support triaged; resolved as client-side retry policy.

ashley: Thanks @sam @lee @maria everyone. Closing thread. :tada:
